# sigma_deployment_policy_file (Resource)

Attaches one file (workbook, data model, report, or folder inode) to a deployment policy. Composite ID `<deployment_policy_id>:<inode_id>`. Use one resource instance per file (e.g. with `for_each`) to attach several.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a file (workbook, data model, report, or folder inode) to a
# deployment policy. One resource instance per file — use for_each over a
# list of inode IDs to attach many.
resource "sigma_deployment_policy_file" "dashboard" {
  deployment_policy_id = sigma_deployment_policy.prod_rollout.id
  inode_id             = "<file-inode-id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_policy_id` (String)
- `inode_id` (String) ID of the file/inode to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_deployment_policy_file.example '<deployment_policy_id>:<inode_id>'
```
